## History

Gideon Duckett possessed an exemplary character from his youth and owned an excellent farm. He formed a romantic relationship with Isolde, which they initially kept secret until they were discovered sharing an intimate moment in a garden. Isolde subsequently revealed her engagement to Gideon to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and the couple later married at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill).

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), [v3 ch.Evening P15](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0015), [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), +3 more_

### [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gideon-duckett--isolde-pembroke.md)

Gideon Duckett and [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) share a romantic relationship and are engaged to be married. Their secret love was confirmed when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally discovered them sharing an intimate moment together in a garden, after which Isolde confided the news of their engagement.
